Both opponents checking is exactly when 3-way slowplay is dangerous — too many free-card outs combined. Bet for value plus protection.

IP (BTN), 3-way, both opponents checked showing weakness — this matches Worked Example 2 (Jh9h on Jc7d2s thin value bet IP with air-heavy villain). Small bet folds out air with backdoor equity and gets called by worse Qx, pocket pairs, and 8x. Standard thin-value c-bet.

Strong made bucket — QsJd on Qc8d3s is top pair good kicker. Overpair on a dry low rainbow strongly favours hero's range, but with two opponents and overcards (Q,K,A) live, protection has real value. Strong made bucket — JhJd overpair on 9d6c2h, OOP (SB) first to act 3-way. DO NOT Rule 11 does not apply (rainbow non-paired). Overpair on dry low board with two overcards live in opponents' ranges argues for protection. AA-checks-80% pattern is for 3-bet pots with deep SPR; in single-raised pot, JJ is a clear lead for value plus protection. CHECK is a defensible alternative for pot control.

Slowplaying gives free cards to outdraw the set; flat-calling under-extracts vs both opponents' continuing ranges.

Strong made bucket — QcJd top pair good kicker on Qh7c2s, IP, SPR ~8 (standard). Pot odds ~21% facing CO c-bet of 33 into 90. Raising folds out the worse value portion and isolates against ahead. Realise equity and re-evaluate turn.

Strong made bucket — QcJd top pair good kicker on Qh7c2s, IP, SPR ~15 (deep). Pot odds ~20% facing CO c-bet. Same hand as MW-35/36 at deep SPR. Drawing bucket — AhJh on Kh8h3d facing CO c-bet 33 into 90 at deep SPR ~15. v3.2 KB §1.7 OVERRIDE anchor: villain_air_pct ~0.05 is well below the 0.20 fold-equity threshold, so the nut-FD + Ah blocker carve-out does NOT trigger. Pot odds ~27% with NFD + overcard provides clean call equity; RAISE wastes EV vs villain's value-heavy single-bet calling range without enough air to fold out.
